0.list:
Modern Slavery Statements Register — records-data — https://modernslaveryregister.gov.au/ — Statements filed under the Commonwealth Modern Slavery Act 2018, searchable and downloadable. Reporting is mandatory above the revenue threshold, so a missing statement means something here. — kind: structured — scope: own — skind: database — tags: corporate:statements — trust: record — voice: official
Fair Work Ombudsman — records-data — https://www.fairwork.gov.au/ — Wage and conditions enforcement, including for visa holders — the Ombudsman states that it will not share information about immigration status where a worker comes forward about exploitation. Publishes litigation outcomes and recovered wages by employer. — kind: structured — scope: own — skind: inspectorate — tags: environment:wages ; environment:inspect ; conserve:compensation — trust: record — voice: official
Anti-Slavery Australia — institutional — https://antislavery.org.au/ — A specialist legal and research centre at UTS providing free legal help to people who have experienced trafficking, slavery and forced marriage, plus practical guides on visas and compensation. — kind: institution — scope: own — skind: helpline — tags: organizing:legal ; conserve:legalaid — trust: record — voice: interpretive
Australian Federal Police — report human trafficking and slavery — https://www.afp.gov.au/crimes/human-trafficking — 131 AFP (131 237). The reporting route for trafficking, forced labour and forced marriage. Referral into the Support for Trafficked People Program runs through the AFP, which means the support and the criminal process are linked — a point to weigh with a lawyer before reporting. — kind: structured — skind: justicegov — tags: conserve:hotline ; projects:inspect ; environment:inspect — voice: official
Australian Red Cross — Support for Trafficked People Program — https://www.redcross.org.au/ — Delivers the federally funded support programme for trafficked people: accommodation, living expenses, health care and casework. Entry is via police referral, which is the constraint to understand before anyone reports. — kind: institution — skind: ngo — tags: conserve:shelter ; organizing:help — voice: interpretive
Kids Helpline — https://kidshelpline.com.au/ — 1800 55 1800, free and twenty-four hours for anyone aged 5 to 25, by phone, web chat or email. The web-chat route is the usable one when a child cannot speak aloud where they are. — kind: institution — skind: helpline — tags: conserve:child ; conserve:hotline — voice: interpretive

1.list:
LEFÖ-IBF — intervention centre for trafficked women — https://www.lefoe.at/ — +43 1 796 92 98. The designated victim-protection organisation for women and girls in Austria: shelter, legal accompaniment through both the criminal case and the residence application, and support with compensation claims. Run by an NGO rather than by police, which is the distinction that decides whether a woman without papers can safely walk in. — kind: institution — skind: helpline — tags: conserve:hotline ; conserve:shelter ; conserve:legalaid ; organizing:legal — voice: interpretive
Criminal Police anti-trafficking line — https://www.bmi.gv.at/ — +43 677 61 34 34 34, and an email intake at the Interior Ministry. The police route, as distinct from LEFÖ-IBF above — faster to an investigation, slower and riskier for someone whose immigration status is irregular. In immediate danger the emergency number is 133. — kind: structured — skind: justicegov — tags: conserve:hotline — voice: official

2.list:
Stop Human Trafficking — national helpline — https://www.stophumantrafficking.be/ — +32 78 055 800, during working hours and around the clock for urgent situations. The national entry point, routing to the three recognised specialist centres. Belgium's model is unusual: recognition as a victim, and the residence permit that follows, runs through those centres rather than through police directly. — kind: structured — skind: oversight — tags: conserve:hotline ; conserve:shelter — voice: official
PAG-ASA — https://pag-asa.be/ — One of Belgium's three recognised specialist reception centres, in Brussels, covering both sexual and labour exploitation. Provides accommodation, social and legal support, and the administrative route to a residence permit. — kind: institution — skind: helpline — tags: conserve:shelter ; conserve:legalaid ; organizing:legal ; organizing:help — voice: interpretive
Myria — federal migration centre — https://www.myria.be/ — The independent body that reports annually on trafficking in Belgium and litigates on migrants' rights. Its reports are where the gap between the number identified and the number actually granted status is documented. — kind: structured — skind: oversight — tags: advocacy:watchdog — voice: official

3.list:
Bangladesh Legal Aid and Services Trust (BLAST) — https://www.blast.org.bd/ — Free legal aid across Bangladesh, including labour and migration cases, and public-interest litigation. One of the few routes to representation for a garment or brick-kiln worker. — kind: institution — skind: legalaid — tags: organizing:legal ; conserve:legalaid — voice: interpretive
BRAC — migration programme — https://www.brac.net/ — Runs migration information and support services at district level, including help for returning workers who were defrauded by a recruiter or came home unpaid. — kind: institution — skind: ngo — tags: corporate:recruit ; organizing:help — voice: interpretive
BMET — Bureau of Manpower, Employment and Training — https://bmet.gov.bd/ — Licenses recruiting agencies for overseas employment and holds the clearance record for departing workers. Bangladeshi cases very often begin with a fee several times the legal ceiling, and the licence file is where that is documented. — kind: structured — skind: inspectorate — tags: corporate:recruit — voice: official

4.list:
A21 — national anti-trafficking hotline — https://www.a21.org/ — 0800 20 100, free and twenty-four hours. Run by an NGO, takes anonymous third-party reports, and is the line most commonly given for Bulgaria — a significant origin country within the EU, where recruitment often happens through someone the person already knows. — kind: institution — skind: helpline — tags: conserve:hotline ; conserve:shelter — voice: interpretive
Animus Association Foundation — https://animusassociation.org/ — 0800 1 8676 and +359 2 981 7686, twenty-four hours, for victims of violence and trafficking. Long-established Bulgarian NGO providing counselling, shelter and reintegration. — kind: institution — skind: helpline — tags: conserve:hotline ; conserve:shelter ; organizing:help — voice: interpretive
General Labour Inspectorate — exploitation line — https://www.gli.government.bg/ — +359 700 17 670, weekday office hours, for labour exploitation and rights violations specifically. A different door from the trafficking hotlines: it acts on conditions and pay without anyone having to establish coercion. — kind: structured — skind: inspectorate — tags: environment:inspect ; conserve:compensation — voice: official

5.list:
Cadastro de Empregadores (‘Lista Suja’) — records-data — https://www.gov.br/trabalho-e-emprego/pt-br — The register of employers found by labour inspectors to have subjected workers to conditions analogous to slavery, published by the Ministry of Labour and Employment every six months under Portaria Interministerial 18/2024. Names, states and sectors, with each employer listed for two years. The April 2026 update added 169 employers, bringing the register to 613 and reflecting some 2,200 workers removed from such conditions. Nothing else in the world is this specific or this public. — kind: structured — scope: own — skind: inspectorate — tags: projects:inspect ; spending:debarred ; environment:inspect — trust: record — voice: official
SmartLab — Observatory on slave labour and trafficking — records-data — https://smartlabbr.org/trabalhoescravo — A joint MPT and ILO observatory turning the inspection data into open dashboards: rescues by year, state, sector, age and gender, going back to 1995. The analytical layer on top of the raw register. — kind: structured — scope: own — skind: research — tags: projects:trackers ; records:stats — trust: record — voice: interpretive
Ministério Público do Trabalho (MPT) — records-data — https://mpt.mp.br/ — The labour prosecution service that brings the civil and criminal actions following an inspection, and publishes its own case reporting. A complaint can be filed with the MPT directly. — kind: structured — scope: own — skind: justicegov — tags: courts:criminal ; courts:civil ; projects:inspect — trust: record — voice: official
Repórter Brasil — investigative-journalism — https://reporterbrasil.org.br/ — The investigative organisation that has covered slave labour in Brazilian supply chains for two decades, with named-company reporting and its own monitoring tools. Much of what the world knows about Brazilian supply chains started here. — kind: journalism — scope: own — skind: media — tags: advocacy:journalism ; corporate:supply — trust: record — voice: interpretive
Disque 100 — human rights hotline — https://www.gov.br/mdh/pt-br/ouvidoria — Dial 100. The national human-rights channel, which takes anonymous reports of work analogous to slavery and of child labour and routes them to the labour inspectorate and the Public Ministry. The route most third-party reports take in Brazil. — kind: structured — skind: helpline — tags: conserve:hotline — voice: official
Comissão Pastoral da Terra — https://www.cptnacional.org.br/ — Receives complaints from rural workers across Brazil and has been the origin of a large share of inspection operations in agriculture and cattle. The point of contact when the worker is remote and has no other way to reach an authority. — kind: institution — skind: ngo — tags: organizing:help ; conserve:hotline — voice: interpretive
Defensoria Pública da União — https://www.dpu.def.br/ — The federal public defender, free to anyone who cannot afford a lawyer, and the body that represents rescued workers in claims for unpaid wages and damages after an operation. The MPT prosecutes; the DPU represents the worker. — kind: structured — skind: legalaid — tags: organizing:legal ; conserve:legalaid ; conserve:compensation — voice: official

6.list:
Forced and child labour in supply chains — reports — records-data — https://www.publicsafety.gc.ca/cnt/cntrng-crm/frcd-lbr-cndn-spply-chns/index-en.aspx — Reports filed under the Fighting Against Forced Labour and Child Labour in Supply Chains Act, plus the joint UK/Australia/Canada reporting template. Canadian reports must be approved by the governing body and signed by a director — a named person is accountable for the contents. — kind: structured — scope: own — skind: database — tags: corporate:statements — trust: record — voice: official
Canadian Human Trafficking Hotline — institutional — https://www.canadianhumantraffickinghotline.ca/ — 1-833-900-1010, 24 hours, multilingual, confidential, with referral to services across the country. — kind: institution — scope: own — skind: helpline — tags: conserve:hotline — trust: record — voice: interpretive
Public Safety Canada — human trafficking — https://www.publicsafety.gc.ca/cnt/cntrng-crm/hmn-trffckng/index-en.aspx — The federal coordination point, national strategy and the temporary resident permit route for trafficking victims, which is what prevents removal while a case is assessed. — kind: structured — skind: oversight — tags: conserve:legalaid — voice: official
Kids Help Phone — https://kidshelpphone.ca/ — 1-800-668-6868, or text CONNECT to 686868. Reaches children directly in English and French, which matters where a young person cannot safely have an adult make the call for them. — kind: institution — skind: helpline — tags: conserve:child ; conserve:hotline — voice: interpretive

7.list: FIZ — Advocacy and Support for Migrant Women and Victims of Trafficking — https://www.fiz-info.ch/ — Zurich-based specialist agency providing shelter, counselling and legal accompaniment, and the organisation that has documented how cantonal differences in Switzerland change what a victim is actually entitled to. — kind: institution — skind: helpline — tags: conserve:hotline ; conserve:shelter ; conserve:legalaid ; organizing:legal ; organizing:help — voice: interpretive

8.list: China Labour Bulletin — institutional — https://clb.org.hk/ — Hong Kong-based, tracking worker actions, wage arrears and workplace accidents across mainland China from public and social-media sources. Because independent unions do not exist there, this is one of very few systematic public records of Chinese labour disputes. — kind: institution — scope: own — skind: ngo — tags: environment:freedom ; environment:wages ; advocacy:data — trust: record — voice: interpretive

9.list: International Cocoa Initiative — Côte d'Ivoire — institutional — https://www.cocoainitiative.org/ — Community child-labour monitoring and remediation in the world's largest cocoa-producing country, with published findings by cooperative and district. Cocoa from Côte d'Ivoire appears on the US Department of Labor list for both child labour and forced labour. — kind: institution — scope: own — skind: ngo — tags: projects:trackers ; conserve:child — trust: record — voice: interpretive

10.list:
BAFA — Supply Chain Act (LkSG) complaints — records-data — https://www.bafa.de/ — The federal office that enforces the Lieferkettensorgfaltspflichtengesetz. Anyone — including a worker or an NGO outside Germany — can file a complaint about a German company's human rights due diligence, and BAFA can investigate and fine. One of the few due-diligence regimes with a real regulator behind it. — kind: structured — scope: own — skind: oversight — tags: courts:grievance ; corporate:statements — trust: record — voice: official
Finanzkontrolle Schwarzarbeit (Zoll) — records-data — https://www.zoll.de/ — Customs' undeclared-work unit, which conducts the workplace inspections that surface exploitation in construction, meat processing and logistics, and enforces the minimum wage. — kind: structured — scope: own — skind: inspectorate — tags: environment:inspect ; environment:wages — trust: record — voice: official
Nummer gegen Kummer — https://www.nummergegenkummer.de/ — 116 111 for children and young people, and a separate parents' line. Anonymous and free, and the German entry point into child protection that does not begin with the police. — kind: institution — skind: helpline — tags: conserve:child ; conserve:hotline — voice: interpretive

11.list: Center mod Menneskehandel (CMM) — https://www.cmm.dk/ — +45 70 20 25 50, twenty-four hours. Denmark's national centre against human trafficking, under the National Board of Social Services: identification, health and social support, and prepared return. Reporting here does not require going to police first. — kind: structured — skind: oversight — tags: conserve:hotline ; conserve:shelter ; organizing:help — voice: official

12.list:
Proyecto ESPERANZA — https://www.proyectoesperanza.org/ — Specialist support for trafficked women in Spain, including labour exploitation as well as sexual exploitation: shelter, legal representation and help with the residence and recovery periods. — kind: institution — skind: ngo — tags: conserve:shelter ; organizing:legal ; conserve:legalaid ; organizing:help — voice: interpretive
Fundación ANAR — https://www.anar.org/ — 116 111 for children and 600 50 51 52 for adults with a concern. Free, confidential, and it does not appear on a phone bill — a detail that matters where the household is the problem. — kind: institution — skind: helpline — tags: conserve:child ; conserve:hotline — voice: interpretive

13.list: Ministry of Labour and Skills — https://mols.gov.et/ — Regulates overseas employment agencies for a corridor — Ethiopia to the Gulf, largely domestic work — that has produced sustained documentation of confiscated passports, unpaid wages and deaths. The licensing register is the practical leverage point. — kind: structured — skind: inspectorate — tags: corporate:recruit ; environment:inspect — voice: official

14.list:
Loi de vigilance — duty of vigilance — records-data — https://www.legifrance.gouv.fr/ — The 2017 statute requiring large French companies to publish a vigilance plan covering their subsidiaries, suppliers and subcontractors, and creating civil liability for failing to. The first law of its kind, and the source of the litigation the EU directive was modelled on. — kind: structured — scope: own — skind: database — tags: corporate:statements ; courts:strategic — trust: record — voice: official
Sherpa — institutional — https://www.asso-sherpa.org/ — The association that brings duty-of-vigilance cases against French multinationals. Its published case files set out the legal theory in detail. — kind: institution — scope: own — skind: helpline — tags: courts:strategic ; organizing:legal — trust: record — voice: interpretive
Comité contre l'esclavage moderne (CCEM) — https://www.esclavagemoderne.org/ — The French organisation specialising in domestic servitude: identification, shelter, and civil actions for unpaid wages and damages against employers, including diplomatic households. — kind: institution — skind: ngo — tags: conserve:shelter ; organizing:legal ; conserve:legalaid ; conserve:compensation — voice: interpretive
119 — Allo Enfance en Danger — https://www.allo119.gouv.fr/ — 119, free and twenty-four hours, the French national number for a child in danger. Takes calls from children and from any adult with a concern, and routes to the departmental child-protection service. — kind: structured — skind: helpline — tags: conserve:child ; conserve:hotline — voice: official

15.list:
Modern Slavery & Exploitation Helpline (Unseen) — institutional — https://www.unseenuk.org/ — 0800 0121 700, 24 hours, confidential, independent of government and police — for potential victims, for the public, and for businesses. Unseen also publishes annual data on what the helpline receives, which is one of the few public pictures of the UK caseload. — kind: institution — scope: own — skind: helpline — tags: conserve:hotline ; conserve:shelter — trust: record — voice: interpretive
Gangmasters and Labour Abuse Authority — records-data — https://www.gla.gov.uk/ — The UK's labour-market enforcement body: licenses labour providers in agriculture, horticulture, shellfish and food processing, and since the Immigration Act 2016 investigates labour exploitation across the whole economy with police-style powers. Report to 0800 432 0804 or via its online form. Supplying labour unlicensed in the regulated sector carries up to ten years. — kind: structured — scope: own — skind: inspectorate — tags: environment:inspect ; corporate:recruit ; projects:inspect — trust: record — voice: official
Independent Anti-Slavery Commissioner — institutional — https://www.antislaverycommissioner.co.uk/ — The statutory office that scrutinises the UK response, publishes on identification, support and prosecution rates, and can require public bodies to cooperate. — kind: institution — scope: own — skind: oversight — tags: advocacy:watchdog ; conserve:legalaid — trust: record — voice: official
Companies House — records-data — https://find-and-update.company-information.service.gov.uk/ — Free company registry: officers, filings, accounts, persons with significant control. The first check on any UK entity named on a contract or a licence. — kind: structured — scope: own — skind: database — tags: corporate:ownership ; people:professional — trust: record — voice: official
Employment tribunal decisions — records-data — https://www.gov.uk/employment-tribunal-decisions — Full-text searchable tribunal judgments. Search an employer for unlawful-deduction, minimum-wage and unfair-dismissal findings — the paper trail that precedes most exploitation cases. — kind: structured — scope: own — skind: court — tags: courts:civil ; environment:wages — trust: record — voice: official
WhatDoTheyKnow — records-data — https://www.whatdotheyknow.com/ — Files and publishes Freedom of Information requests to UK public bodies. Requests and responses are public, so someone may already have asked what you need. — kind: structured — scope: own — skind: foi — tags: records:foia — trust: record — voice: interpretive
Focus on Labour Exploitation (FLEX) — institutional — https://labourexploitation.org/ — Research and policy on labour exploitation in the UK, with detailed work on enforcement gaps, the seasonal worker visa and the interaction between immigration control and victim identification. — kind: institution — scope: own — skind: ngo — tags: advocacy:watchdog ; organizing:help — trust: record — voice: interpretive
ATLEU — Anti-Trafficking and Labour Exploitation Unit — institutional — https://atleu.org.uk/ — Specialist legal representation for victims of trafficking and labour exploitation — compensation, immigration and public-law challenges — plus training and resources for other lawyers. — kind: institution — scope: own — skind: helpline — tags: organizing:legal ; conserve:legalaid ; conserve:compensation — trust: record — voice: interpretive
HM Land Registry — records-data — https://www.gov.uk/government/organisations/land-registry — Who owns the property — including the house or hostel workers are accommodated in, and overseas-company ownership of UK land. In labour-exploitation cases the accommodation and the employer are frequently the same interest. — kind: structured — scope: own — skind: database — tags: financial:property — trust: record — voice: official
Modern Slavery & Exploitation Helpline (Unseen) — https://www.unseenuk.org/modern-slavery-helpline/ — 0800 0121 700, twenty-four hours. Independent of government and of police, takes reports from workers, from the public and from businesses, and can refer into support without an immigration referral being the first thing that happens. The most commonly recommended first call in the UK. — kind: structured — skind: helpline — tags: conserve:hotline ; conserve:shelter — voice: official
Gangmasters and Labour Abuse Authority — https://www.gla.gov.uk/report-issues/ — 0800 432 0804. Licenses labour providers in agriculture, shellfish and food processing, and investigates labour exploitation across the wider economy. Reporting an unlicensed or abusive gangmaster here can pull a licence in weeks, which is far faster than any prosecution, and the licensing register lets you check a provider before anyone signs anything. — kind: structured — skind: inspectorate — tags: projects:inspect ; environment:inspect ; environment:inspect — voice: official
National Referral Mechanism — https://www.gov.uk/government/publications/human-trafficking-victims-referral-and-assessment-forms — The statutory route by which someone is formally identified as a victim of modern slavery, which is what unlocks support and a period of leave. Referral must be made by a designated first responder — not by any member of the public — so the practical step is contacting one of the first-responder organisations. Adults must consent; children are referred regardless. — kind: structured — skind: oversight — tags: conserve:legalaid — voice: official
Modern Slavery Statement Registry — https://modern-slavery-statement-registry.service.gov.uk/ — Search what any UK-linked company has published under s.54 of the Modern Slavery Act. Submission is currently voluntary, which is itself the finding in many cases: check whether the company you are looking at has filed at all, and compare this year's statement with last year's. — kind: institution — skind: database — tags: corporate:statements — voice: interpretive
Kalayaan — https://www.kalayaan.org.uk/ — Advice and casework for migrant domestic workers in the UK — the group that has documented what the tied overseas domestic worker visa does in practice, which is that leaving an abusive employer means losing the right to be in the country. — kind: institution — skind: ngo — tags: organizing:legal ; conserve:legalaid ; organizing:help ; conserve:shelter — voice: interpretive
Unseen — donate — https://www.unseenuk.org/donate/ — Runs the UK Modern Slavery & Exploitation Helpline and safe houses. Unrestricted giving here funds the line itself, which is the hardest thing in this sector to fund and the first thing to be cut. — kind: institution — skind: ngo — tags: organizing:fund — voice: interpretive
NSPCC helpline — https://www.nspcc.org.uk/keeping-children-safe/reporting-abuse/ — 0808 800 5000, for adults worried about a child. Takes a call from anyone, including anonymously, and can refer to children's services or police. Use it when what you have is a concern rather than evidence — that is what it is for, and waiting for certainty is how cases are missed. — kind: institution — skind: helpline — tags: conserve:child ; conserve:hotline — voice: interpretive

16.list: International Cocoa Initiative — Ghana — institutional — https://www.cocoainitiative.org/ — The multi-stakeholder foundation running child-labour monitoring and remediation systems in cocoa-growing communities in Ghana and Côte d'Ivoire, and publishing what those systems find. The most detailed public evidence base on child labour in any single commodity. — kind: institution — scope: own — skind: ngo — tags: projects:trackers ; conserve:child — trust: record — voice: interpretive

17.list: A21 Greece — national hotline 1109 — https://www.a21.org/ — 1109, free and twenty-four hours, run in partnership with the Greek state. Greece is both a destination for agricultural labour and a major arrival point, and the two situations reach this line differently — say which it is when you call. — kind: institution — skind: helpline — tags: conserve:hotline ; conserve:shelter — voice: interpretive

18.list:
Liberty Shared — https://libertyshared.org/ — Files forced-labour petitions with customs authorities, works on financial-sector detection of trafficking proceeds, and produces the supply-chain research behind several import bans — including the petition that led to the Sime Darby palm oil order. — kind: institution — skind: ngo — tags: advocacy:data ; corporate:supply ; courts:grievance — voice: interpretive
Mission for Migrant Workers — https://www.migrants.net/ — Direct casework, shelter and wage claims for foreign domestic workers in Hong Kong, where the live-in requirement and the two-week rule are the two structural pressures that keep people in abusive placements. — kind: institution — skind: ngo — tags: conserve:shelter ; organizing:help ; conserve:compensation — voice: interpretive

19.list:
BP2MI — Indonesian Migrant Workers Protection Agency — records-data — https://bp2mi.go.id/ — Regulates and records the placement of Indonesian workers abroad, publishes placement data by destination and province, and handles complaints against recruitment companies. — kind: structured — scope: own — skind: court — tags: corporate:recruit ; records:stats — trust: record — voice: official
Migrant CARE — https://migrantcare.net/ — Advocacy and casework for Indonesian migrant workers, including cases of workers detained abroad and of recruitment debt incurred before departure. — kind: institution — skind: ngo — tags: corporate:recruit ; organizing:help ; organizing:legal ; conserve:legalaid — voice: interpretive

20.list:
PENCiL portal — report child labour — records-data — https://pencil.gov.in/ — The Ministry of Labour and Employment's online platform for reporting child labour and tracking the complaint. Complaints route to the district nodal officer; the portal also carries state-level enforcement data. — kind: structured — scope: own — skind: inspectorate — tags: conserve:child ; projects:inspect — trust: record — voice: official
Ministry of Labour and Employment — records-data — https://labour.gov.in/ — The Bonded Labour System (Abolition) Act 1976 and the Child and Adolescent Labour (Prohibition and Regulation) Act, the rehabilitation scheme for released bonded labourers, and the district vigilance committees that are supposed to run it. — kind: structured — scope: own — skind: court — tags: environment:inspect ; conserve:compensation — trust: record — voice: official
National Human Rights Commission — records-data — https://nhrc.nic.in/ — Takes complaints about bonded labour and child labour directly, including by post and online, and has its own investigation powers. In practice one of the more responsive national routes. — kind: structured — scope: own — skind: oversight — tags: courts:grievance ; conserve:legalaid — trust: record — voice: official
eCourts services — records-data — https://ecourts.gov.in/ — Case status and orders across district and high courts. Search a company, a contractor or a case number. — kind: structured — scope: own — skind: court — tags: courts:criminal ; courts:civil — trust: record — voice: official
RTI Online — records-data — https://rtionline.gov.in/ — File a Right to Information request to central government bodies. Thirty-day statutory deadline, small fee, and a first-appeal route when refused. — kind: structured — scope: own — skind: foi — tags: records:foia — trust: record — voice: official
MCA — company master data — records-data — https://www.mca.gov.in/ — The Ministry of Corporate Affairs registry: directors, registered offices and filings for Indian companies. — kind: structured — scope: own — skind: database — tags: corporate:ownership — trust: record — voice: official
Childline 1098 — https://www.childlineindia.org/ — The national child helpline, 1098, free and twenty-four hours. Takes calls about a child in danger from anyone, including from children themselves, and connects to district child-protection machinery. The standard first call for a child found working. — kind: structured — skind: helpline — tags: conserve:hotline ; conserve:child — voice: official
National Human Rights Commission — https://nhrc.nic.in/complaints/lodge-complaint — Takes complaints directly, including about official inaction, and has taken up bonded-labour cases where district authorities did not act. Filing is free and can be done online by anyone on behalf of anyone. — kind: structured — skind: oversight — tags: courts:grievance — voice: official
International Justice Mission — India — https://www.ijm.org/ — Works with district authorities on bonded-labour rescue operations and on the aftercare and prosecution that follow, in several states. Relevant as the operational partner when a case needs a rescue rather than a complaint. — kind: institution — skind: ngo — tags: conserve:shelter ; organizing:help — voice: interpretive
Bachpan Bachao Andolan — https://www.bba.org.in/ — Long-running child-rights organisation that conducts rescues from child labour and trafficking and pursues the prosecutions afterwards. Takes information about a specific child or workplace. — kind: institution — skind: ngo — tags: conserve:child ; organizing:help — voice: interpretive
Human Rights Law Network — https://hrln.org/ — A national network of lawyers taking public-interest cases including bonded labour, with offices in most states. Files public interest litigation, which in India has been the route that forced district administrations to act where individual complaints did not. — kind: institution — skind: legalaid — tags: organizing:legal ; conserve:legalaid ; courts:strategic — voice: interpretive
eMigrate — check a recruiting agent — https://emigrate.gov.in/ — The Ministry of External Affairs system for emigration clearance, carrying the register of licensed recruiting agents. Check the agent here before anyone pays a fee: an unlicensed agent is itself an offence and a far faster case than proving exploitation after the fact. — kind: structured — skind: inspectorate — tags: corporate:recruit — voice: official

21.list:
Migrant Rights Centre Ireland — https://www.mrci.ie/ — Casework and organising with migrant workers in Ireland, with a long record on forced labour in fishing, agriculture and domestic work, and on the permit system that ties workers to one employer. — kind: institution — skind: ngo — tags: organizing:help ; organizing:legal ; conserve:legalaid ; organizing:help — voice: interpretive
ISPCC Childline — https://www.ispcc.ie/childline/ — 1800 66 66 66, free and twenty-four hours, plus text and live chat. Ireland's national listening service for children. — kind: institution — skind: helpline — tags: conserve:child ; conserve:hotline — voice: interpretive

22.list:
Numero Verde Anti-Tratta — 800 290 290 — https://www.pariopportunita.gov.it/ — Italy's national anti-trafficking freephone line, twenty-four hours and multilingual, run under the Department for Equal Opportunities. Takes anonymous reports and routes to the regional anti-trafficking projects that provide shelter and status support. — kind: structured — skind: helpline — tags: conserve:hotline ; conserve:shelter — voice: official
Osservatorio Placido Rizzotto (FLAI-CGIL) — https://www.flai.it/osservatoriopr/ — The union observatory that documents caporalato — illicit labour brokering in Italian agriculture — and publishes the periodic report that names the sectors and provinces where it concentrates. — kind: institution — skind: union — tags: organizing:help ; advocacy:data — voice: interpretive
Telefono Azzurro — https://azzurro.it/ — 19696, free and twenty-four hours, for children and for adults reporting concern about one. Italy's oldest child-protection line, and it also handles online exploitation reports. — kind: institution — skind: helpline — tags: conserve:child ; conserve:hotline — voice: interpretive

23.list:
Ministry of Labour and Social Protection — records-data — https://www.labour.go.ke/ — Labour inspection, the National Employment Authority which regulates private recruitment agencies placing Kenyans in the Gulf, and the child-labour unit. — kind: structured — scope: own — skind: inspectorate — tags: environment:inspect ; corporate:recruit — trust: record — voice: official
HAART Kenya — https://haartkenya.org/ — Kenya's principal anti-trafficking NGO: rescue, shelter, reintegration and legal support, plus research on the Gulf recruitment corridor that most Kenyan cases run through. — kind: institution — skind: ngo — tags: organizing:help ; conserve:shelter ; organizing:legal ; conserve:legalaid — voice: interpretive
Childline Kenya — https://childlinekenya.co.ke/ — 116, free from any network, twenty-four hours, run with the Department of Children's Services. The national route for reporting a child in labour or at risk. — kind: institution — skind: helpline — tags: conserve:child ; conserve:hotline — voice: interpretive

24.list: Central — Cambodian Alliance of Trade Unions support — https://www.central-cambodia.org/ — Cambodian labour-rights organisation providing legal support and documentation for garment, construction and migrant workers, including workers recruited into Thailand and Malaysia. — kind: institution — skind: ngo — tags: organizing:legal ; organizing:help ; conserve:compensation — voice: interpretive

25.list: KAFA — https://kafa.org.lb/ — Works with migrant domestic workers in Lebanon, where the sponsorship system leaves workers outside labour law entirely. Provides a helpline, shelter referral and legal support, and has documented the pattern of confiscated passports and unpaid wages. — kind: institution — skind: ngo — tags: conserve:hotline ; conserve:shelter ; organizing:legal ; conserve:legalaid — voice: interpretive

26.list: Sri Lanka Bureau of Foreign Employment — https://www.slbfe.lk/ — Registers migrant workers and licenses recruitment agencies, and runs a welfare fund that pays compensation in death and injury cases abroad. Registration before departure is what makes a worker eligible for that fund — unregistered departure is common and forfeits it. — kind: structured — skind: inspectorate — tags: corporate:recruit — voice: official

27.list:
Secretaría del Trabajo y Previsión Social — records-data — https://www.gob.mx/stps — Federal labour inspection and the PROFEDET labour-defence service, which represents workers free of charge in wage and reinstatement claims. — kind: structured — scope: own — skind: inspectorate — tags: environment:inspect ; conserve:legalaid — trust: record — voice: official
Gobierno de México — labour and trafficking reporting — https://www.gob.mx/ — Federal portal covering the labour inspectorate and the reporting routes for trafficking. Mexico appears on the US list of goods for child labour in sugarcane and forced labour in tomato production, so agricultural labour is where most documented cases sit. — kind: structured — skind: court — tags: projects:inspect ; environment:inspect ; environment:inspect — voice: official
Consejo Ciudadano — anti-trafficking line — https://consejociudadanomx.org/ — Civil-society helpline taking trafficking reports in Mexico, including anonymous third-party reports, with referral to legal and psychological support. — kind: institution — skind: ngo — tags: conserve:hotline ; conserve:shelter — voice: interpretive

28.list: Migrant Assistance Programme (MAP) Foundation — https://www.mapfoundationcm.org/ — Works with Burmese migrant workers, most of them in Thailand, on labour rights, documentation and access to compensation. Operates cross-border, which is what the situation requires. — kind: institution — skind: ngo — tags: organizing:help ; conserve:compensation — voice: interpretive

29.list:
Jabatan Tenaga Kerja (Labour Department) — records-data — https://jtksm.mohr.gov.my/ — The peninsular labour department, which handles wage claims and inspects workplaces including plantations and manufacturing. Migrant workers can file claims, though the employer-tied permit makes it risky in practice. — kind: structured — scope: own — skind: inspectorate — tags: environment:wages ; environment:inspect — trust: record — voice: official
Tenaganita — institutional — https://tenaganita.net/ — A long-standing Malaysian organisation working directly with migrant workers, refugees and trafficking survivors, with casework, shelter and documentation of conditions in plantations and factories. — kind: institution — scope: own — skind: ngo — tags: organizing:help ; conserve:shelter — trust: record — voice: interpretive

30.list:
NAPTIP — records-data — https://naptip.gov.ng/ — The National Agency for the Prohibition of Trafficking in Persons, created in 2003 and operating nationwide under the Trafficking in Persons (Prohibition) Enforcement and Administration Act as amended in 2015. Its mandate expressly covers forced labour, child labour and bonded labour as well as sexual exploitation, and it runs shelters and a reporting line. — kind: structured — scope: own — skind: justicegov — tags: projects:inspect ; conserve:hotline ; conserve:shelter ; courts:criminal — trust: record — voice: official
NACTAL — network of anti-trafficking organisations — institutional — https://nactal.org/ — The umbrella body for Nigerian NGOs working on trafficking, child labour and abuse — the route to a member organisation in a specific state rather than the federal agency. — kind: institution — scope: own — skind: ngo — tags: organizing:help ; conserve:shelter — trust: record — voice: interpretive
NAPTIP — report trafficking — https://www.naptip.gov.ng/ — The National Agency for the Prohibition of Trafficking in Persons, established 2003, with a mandate expressly covering forced labour and child labour as well as trafficking. It investigates, prosecutes and runs shelters, and takes reports from the public through its offices and hotline. — kind: structured — skind: oversight — tags: conserve:hotline ; projects:inspect ; environment:inspect ; conserve:shelter — voice: official
Devatop Centre for Africa Development — https://devatop.org/ — Nigerian anti-trafficking organisation running community reporting, training and survivor support, and one of the groups NAPTIP works with on referral. — kind: institution — skind: ngo — tags: organizing:help ; organizing:fund — voice: interpretive
Cece Yara Foundation — https://www.ceceyara.org/ — 0800 800 8001, a child-focused helpline in Nigeria providing counselling, medical and legal support, and case follow-through rather than only referral. — kind: institution — skind: helpline — tags: conserve:child ; conserve:hotline — voice: interpretive

31.list:
Nederlandse Arbeidsinspectie — records-data — https://www.nlarbeidsinspectie.nl/ — The Dutch labour inspectorate, which investigates labour exploitation as well as ordinary employment breaches and publishes inspection results. Reports can be made anonymously. — kind: structured — scope: own — skind: inspectorate — tags: environment:inspect ; projects:inspect — trust: record — voice: official
CoMensha — institutional — https://www.comensha.nl/ — The national coordination centre on human trafficking: registers victims, arranges shelter and care, and publishes national figures. — kind: institution — scope: own — skind: shelter — tags: conserve:shelter ; conserve:hotline — trust: record — voice: interpretive
FairWork — https://www.fairwork.nu/ — Dutch organisation working on labour exploitation and trafficking: outreach to workers in agriculture, meat processing and cleaning, and support through the reporting and referral process. — kind: institution — skind: ngo — tags: organizing:help ; conserve:shelter — voice: interpretive
De Kindertelefoon — https://www.kindertelefoon.nl/ — 0800 0432, free and not shown on the bill, for children who want to talk to someone outside the household. Chat as well as phone. — kind: institution — skind: helpline — tags: conserve:child ; conserve:hotline — voice: interpretive

32.list:
Forbrukertilsynet — Transparency Act — records-data — https://www.forbrukertilsynet.no/ — The consumer authority enforces the Åpenhetsloven. Its distinctive feature is the right to information: any person may ask any covered company how it handles human rights risks in its chain, and the company must answer within three weeks. No standing, no fee, no lawyer. — kind: structured — scope: own — skind: oversight — tags: records:access ; corporate:statements ; courts:grievance — trust: record — voice: official
ROSA project — https://rosa-help.no/ — +47 22 33 11 60, twenty-four hours. Norway's national assistance and coordination service for trafficked people: safe accommodation anywhere in the country, and follow-up through the reflection-period application. — kind: institution — skind: helpline — tags: conserve:hotline ; conserve:shelter ; conserve:legalaid ; organizing:legal — voice: interpretive

33.list:
Maiti Nepal — https://maitinepal.org/ — The best-known anti-trafficking organisation in Nepal: interception at border points, shelters, legal aid and reintegration. Nepal is overwhelmingly an origin country, so most of the work is at the border and in the recruitment stage rather than at a workplace. — kind: institution — skind: ngo — tags: conserve:hotline ; conserve:shelter ; organizing:help ; organizing:legal ; conserve:legalaid — voice: interpretive
Foreign Employment Board — https://fepb.gov.np/ — The state body handling Nepali migrant workers going abroad, including the welfare fund that pays compensation to families when a worker dies or is injured overseas. Check a recruiter's licence here before anyone pays a fee. — kind: structured — skind: inspectorate — tags: corporate:recruit ; conserve:compensation — voice: official
CWIN Child Helpline 1098 — https://cwin.org.np/ — 1098, run by CWIN, Nepal's longest-running child-rights organisation. Handles rescue and rehabilitation of children in labour, including children trafficked into work in India. — kind: institution — skind: helpline — tags: conserve:child ; conserve:hotline — voice: interpretive

34.list: Ministry of Human Rights — records-data — https://mohr.gov.pk/ — The federal ministry with the bonded-labour and child-labour brief, including the 1043 human rights helpline. Enforcement of the Bonded Labour System (Abolition) Act is largely devolved to the provinces, so provincial labour departments are the operative level. — kind: structured — scope: own — skind: court — tags: conserve:hotline ; environment:inspect — trust: record — voice: official

35.list:
Department of Migrant Workers — records-data — https://dmw.gov.ph/ — Licenses and regulates recruitment agencies deploying Filipino workers abroad, publishes the list of licensed agencies and those suspended or cancelled, and handles complaints against them. The single most useful register for a Filipino worker's recruitment chain. — kind: structured — scope: own — skind: court — tags: corporate:recruit ; conserve:legalaid — trust: record — voice: official
IACAT — Inter-Agency Council Against Trafficking — records-data — https://iacat.gov.ph/ — The national anti-trafficking body, with the 1343 Actionline reporting number and coordination across law enforcement, social welfare and foreign affairs. — kind: structured — scope: own — skind: justicegov — tags: conserve:hotline ; courts:criminal — trust: record — voice: official
Center for Migrant Advocacy — https://centerformigrantadvocacy.com/ — Casework and policy work for Filipino migrant workers, including repatriation and claims against recruitment agencies. Complements the government route, which is often slower for a worker already abroad. — kind: institution — skind: ngo — tags: corporate:recruit ; organizing:help ; organizing:legal ; conserve:legalaid — voice: interpretive
Bantay Bata 163 — https://www.bantaybata163.com/ — 163, a national child-welfare helpline taking reports of abuse, neglect and child labour, with rescue and case management behind it. — kind: institution — skind: helpline — tags: conserve:child ; conserve:hotline — voice: interpretive

36.list:
La Strada Poland — National Intervention and Consultation Centre — https://www.strada.org.pl/ — Runs Poland's national consultation centre for victims of trafficking under contract to the Interior Ministry: crisis intervention, shelter, and legal and interpreting support. Poland is both a destination for workers from further east and an origin country, and this centre handles both directions. — kind: institution — skind: helpline — tags: conserve:hotline ; conserve:shelter ; conserve:legalaid ; organizing:legal ; organizing:help — voice: interpretive
National Labour Inspectorate (PIP) — https://www.pip.gov.pl/ — Handles complaints about pay, hours and conditions, including from foreign workers, and can act without an immigration referral. The practical route when the situation is unpaid and coercive but not yet provably trafficking. — kind: structured — skind: inspectorate — tags: environment:inspect ; conserve:compensation — voice: official

37.list:
APAV — Portuguese Association for Victim Support — https://apav.pt/ — 116 006, the national victim support line, with a dedicated trafficking unit (UAVMD). Free legal and psychological support, and help through the criminal process and compensation claims. — kind: institution — skind: helpline — tags: conserve:hotline ; conserve:shelter ; conserve:legalaid ; organizing:legal ; conserve:compensation — voice: interpretive
Observatório do Tráfico de Seres Humanos — https://www.otsh.mai.gov.pt/ — The state observatory that publishes Portugal's identification and referral statistics, including the split between labour and sexual exploitation. Portuguese agriculture has produced repeated documented cases involving workers recruited from South and Southeast Asia. — kind: structured — skind: oversight — tags: advocacy:watchdog ; records:stats — voice: official

38.list:
Ministry of Labour — records-data — https://www.mol.gov.qa/ — Labour complaints, the Workers' Support and Insurance Fund, and the post-2020 rules allowing a job change without employer consent and setting a minimum wage. Read the rules alongside independent reporting on how often they are actually applied. — kind: structured — scope: own — skind: inspectorate — tags: environment:wages ; conserve:compensation — trust: record — voice: official
Ministry of Labour — complaints and dispute committees — https://www.mol.gov.qa/en/ — Files a wage or contract complaint, which routes to the labour dispute resolution committees. Since the 2020 reforms a worker may change employer without the sponsor's consent and a non-discriminatory minimum wage applies. Enforcement is the contested part: monitoring organisations continue to document blocked transfers and withheld wages, so treat the rule and the practice as separate questions. — kind: structured — skind: inspectorate — tags: conserve:compensation ; environment:inspect — voice: official
Migrant-Rights.org — https://www.migrant-rights.org/ — Independent reporting and data on migrant workers across the Gulf: what each country's sponsorship rules actually say now, wage theft, worker deaths, and what changed when a reform was announced. The reference point when a government statement needs checking. — kind: institution — skind: ngo — tags: advocacy:watchdog — voice: interpretive
Migrant Workers' Rights — legal support — https://www.ilo.org/beirut — The ILO's regional office for the Arab States, which runs the technical cooperation programme in Qatar and publishes what the labour dispute committees are actually delivering. The place to check a claim about reform against the monitoring. — kind: structured — skind: igo — tags: environment:inspect ; advocacy:watchdog — voice: official

39.list:
ANITP — National Agency against Trafficking in Persons — https://anitp.mai.gov.ro/ — Romania's national coordinating agency, with regional centres and a national helpline. Romania is consistently among the largest origin countries for people identified as trafficked elsewhere in the EU, so the agency's role in reintegration of returning citizens is as important as its domestic casework. — kind: structured — skind: oversight — tags: conserve:hotline ; conserve:shelter ; advocacy:watchdog — voice: official
eLiberare — https://www.eliberare.com/ — Romanian anti-trafficking organisation working on prevention, survivor support and practitioner training, with material aimed at people who suspect a case rather than only at professionals. — kind: institution — skind: ngo — tags: organizing:help ; organizing:fund — voice: interpretive

40.list: HOME — Humanitarian Organization for Migration Economics — https://www.home.org.sg/ — Shelter, casework and a helpline for migrant workers and domestic workers in Singapore, and the organisation that documents what salary non-payment and repatriation look like in practice there. — kind: institution — skind: ngo — tags: conserve:hotline ; conserve:shelter ; organizing:help ; conserve:compensation — voice: interpretive

41.list:
National Support Line against Prostitution and Trafficking (NSPM) — https://jamstalldhetsmyndigheten.se/ — 020-390 000. Run under the Gender Equality Agency, this line advises both people in the situation and professionals who encounter one — which makes it usable when you are a colleague, a landlord or a nurse who has seen something and does not know what to do next. — kind: structured — skind: oversight — tags: conserve:hotline ; conserve:shelter — voice: official
Swedish Work Environment Authority — https://www.av.se/ — Inspects working and living conditions, including employer-provided accommodation, and takes reports about a workplace from anyone. Berry-picking and construction are the two Swedish sectors with a documented record here. — kind: structured — skind: inspectorate — tags: environment:inspect — voice: official

42.list:
Issara Institute — institutional — https://www.issarainstitute.org/ — Worker-voice channels in Thai and regional supply chains: multilingual hotlines and apps that let workers report conditions directly, with the aggregated data fed back to buyers. Built specifically because audits do not detect this. — kind: institution — scope: own — skind: ngo — tags: osint:worker ; organizing:help — trust: record — voice: interpretive
Department of Labour Protection and Welfare — records-data — https://www.labour.go.th/ — Thai labour inspection and wage-claim machinery, including the fishing-sector inspection regime introduced after the EU carding of Thai fisheries. — kind: structured — scope: own — skind: inspectorate — tags: environment:inspect ; environment:wages — trust: record — voice: official
Environmental Justice Foundation — fisheries — https://ejfoundation.org/ — Investigations combining crew testimony with vessel and ownership records. Its reports name vessels, flags and beneficial owners, which is the level of detail a port authority needs before it will act. — kind: institution — skind: ngo — tags: advocacy:data ; osint:vessels — voice: interpretive

43.list: Cotton Campaign — Turkmenistan — institutional — https://www.cottoncampaign.org/ — Documentation of the state-organised cotton harvest, in which public-sector workers are mobilised under threat of dismissal, and the ongoing pledge campaign against Turkmen cotton. — kind: advocacy — scope: own — skind: ngo — tags: advocacy:watchdog ; projects:trackers — trust: record — voice: commentary

44.list: La Strada Ukraine — https://la-strada.org.ua/ — 0 800 500 335, or 116 123 from a mobile. National hotline on trafficking, gender-based violence and children's rights, run by an NGO. Ukraine's displacement since 2022 has made both the outbound recruitment risk and the difficulty of tracing people substantially worse, and this line handles cases in both directions. — kind: institution — skind: helpline — tags: conserve:hotline ; conserve:shelter ; conserve:child ; organizing:help — voice: interpretive

45.list:
National Human Trafficking Hotline — institutional — https://humantraffickinghotline.org/ — 1-888-373-7888, text 233733, or web chat — 24 hours, more than 200 languages. Operated by Polaris, not by law enforcement and not by immigration, which is why people call it. Handles labour trafficking as well as sex trafficking, and will make a referral rather than a report if that is what the person wants. — kind: institution — scope: own — skind: helpline — tags: conserve:hotline ; conserve:shelter — trust: record — voice: interpretive
Office on Trafficking in Persons (HHS) — records-data — https://www.acf.hhs.gov/otip — The federal body that certifies trafficking victims for benefits and runs the National Human Trafficking Referral Directory. Certification is what unlocks federal assistance for a non-citizen survivor, so this is a step, not a leaflet. — kind: structured — scope: own — skind: court — tags: conserve:legalaid ; conserve:longterm — trust: record — voice: official
DOL Wage and Hour Division — child labour enforcement — records-data — https://www.dol.gov/agencies/whd/child-labor — The federal rules on what work minors may do and the division that enforces them. Includes how to file a complaint — which can be made by anyone, not only the worker, and does not require the worker's immigration status to be raised. — kind: structured — scope: own — skind: inspectorate — tags: environment:inspect ; projects:inspect — trust: record — voice: official
DOL enforcement database — records-data — https://enforcedata.dol.gov/ — Every Wage and Hour, OSHA, MSHA and OFCCP enforcement case, downloadable, with employer name, address, violation type, back wages assessed and penalties. Search an employer here before you believe its statement about itself. — kind: structured — scope: own — skind: database — tags: environment:wages ; environment:inspect ; projects:inspect — trust: record — voice: official
OSHA establishment search — records-data — https://www.osha.gov/ords/imis/establishment.html — Inspection history by employer and site: what was found, what was cited, what was contested. Safety citations frequently document the conditions that a forced-labour case later relies on. — kind: structured — scope: own — skind: database — tags: environment:osh — trust: record — voice: official
SEC EDGAR full-text search — records-data — https://efts.sec.gov/LATEST/search-index?q= — Every filing by every US-listed company, full-text searchable. Search a supplier's name across all filings to find which listed companies have disclosed a relationship with it. — kind: structured — scope: own — skind: database — tags: corporate:statements ; corporate:supply — trust: record — voice: official
USAspending.gov — records-data — https://www.usaspending.gov/ — Every federal contract, grant and payment, by recipient. If a supplier you are investigating holds federal contracts, there is an inspector general and a contracting officer already attached to it. — kind: structured — scope: own — skind: database — tags: spending:contracts — trust: record — voice: official
SAM.gov — exclusions — records-data — https://sam.gov/ — The register of entities barred from federal contracts and assistance, with the reason and the term. Check a company here alongside the customs and UFLPA lists. — kind: structured — scope: own — skind: database — tags: spending:debarred — trust: record — voice: official
FOIA.gov — records-data — https://www.foia.gov/ — Which federal agency holds what, and how to file. Response deadlines are statutory; agencies miss them routinely, and the appeal process is part of the tool. — kind: structured — scope: own — skind: foi — tags: records:foia — trust: record — voice: official
CourtListener / RECAP — records-data — https://www.courtlistener.com/ — Free access to federal and many state dockets and opinions, including documents bought out of PACER by other users. Search the employer, the recruiter and the statute. — kind: structured — scope: own — skind: database — tags: courts:criminal ; courts:civil — trust: record — voice: interpretive
California Transparency in Supply Chains Act — records-data — https://oag.ca.gov/SB657 — The 2010 statute that required large retailers and manufacturers doing business in California to disclose their efforts against slavery and trafficking in their supply chains — the predecessor of the UK, Australian and Canadian regimes, and still in force. — kind: structured — scope: own — skind: court — tags: corporate:statements — trust: record — voice: official
Coalition of Immokalee Workers — Fair Food Program — institutional — https://fairfoodprogram.org/ — Worker-driven social responsibility: binding agreements between growers and buyers, a worker-staffed complaint line, and independent auditing with real consequences. Cited repeatedly as the model that works where social auditing does not. — kind: institution — scope: own — skind: union — tags: organizing:help ; environment:freedom ; corporate:audit — trust: record — voice: interpretive
Farmworker Justice — institutional — https://www.farmworkerjustice.org/ — Legal and policy work on US agricultural labour, including the H-2A guestworker programme where employer-tied visas and recruitment debt produce the classic pattern. — kind: institution — scope: own — skind: helpline — tags: organizing:legal ; corporate:recruit — trust: record — voice: interpretive
FinCEN — human trafficking financial advisories — records-data — https://www.fincen.gov/resources/advisories — The financial-intelligence unit's red-flag guidance on human trafficking and forced labour: the transaction patterns banks are told to look for — wages paid to a single account for many workers, recruitment-fee flows, funds moving to a labour broker. Useful in reverse, as a checklist of what to look for in the financial record you already have. — kind: structured — scope: own — skind: oversight — tags: financial:aml ; financial:remit — trust: record — voice: official
Human Trafficking Institute — federal case data — institutional — https://traffickinginstitute.org/ — Annual analysis of every federal human trafficking prosecution in the United States, including the small but growing number of forced-labour cases, with defendants, sectors and outcomes. — kind: institution — scope: own — skind: research — tags: courts:criminal ; advocacy:data — trust: record — voice: interpretive
National Human Trafficking Hotline — report or get help — https://humantraffickinghotline.org/en/report-trafficking — 1-888-373-7888, or text 233733. Twenty-four hours, over 200 languages, and it takes reports about someone else as well as calls from people in the situation. It is run by an NGO and is not law enforcement: it will not send police unless you ask it to or someone is in immediate danger, which is the reason many callers use it rather than 911. You do not need to be certain, and you can stay anonymous. — kind: structured — skind: helpline — tags: conserve:hotline ; conserve:shelter — voice: official
Department of Labor — Wage and Hour Division complaint — https://www.dol.gov/agencies/whd/contact/complaints — Files a wage complaint for unpaid or underpaid work. Two things make this the most-used route in practice: it does not ask about immigration status, and it does not require proving coercion — only that the work was done and not paid. Complaints can be filed by a third party. There is a two-year limit, three if the violation was wilful. — kind: structured — skind: inspectorate — tags: conserve:compensation ; environment:inspect — voice: official
OSHA — workplace safety complaint — https://www.osha.gov/workers/file-complaint — Triggers an inspection of a workplace. Worth knowing because an injury or unsafe-conditions complaint reaches a site that no anti-trafficking authority is watching, and the resulting inspection report becomes an official document about a workplace that had none. — kind: structured — skind: inspectorate — tags: environment:inspect — voice: official
USCIS — T and U nonimmigrant status — https://www.uscis.gov/humanitarian/victims-of-human-trafficking-and-other-crimes — The visa categories for trafficking victims (T) and victims of certain crimes who assist an investigation (U). This is the mechanism that stops removal while a case proceeds, and it is the reason status advice has to come before any report is made rather than after. Both are capped and slow; apply through a legal-aid provider rather than alone. — kind: structured — skind: helpline — tags: conserve:legalaid — voice: official
Polaris — https://polarisproject.org/ — Operates the national hotline and publishes the data that comes out of it — typologies of trafficking by industry, and analysis of what callers actually report. Also takes donations that fund the hotline directly. — kind: institution — skind: ngo — tags: organizing:fund ; organizing:help — voice: interpretive
Freedom Network USA — https://freedomnetworkusa.org/ — The national alliance of anti-trafficking legal and service providers. Its member directory is the fastest route to a lawyer or case manager in a specific state who already does this work. — kind: institution — skind: ngo — tags: conserve:legalaid ; organizing:legal ; organizing:help — voice: interpretive
Human Trafficking Legal Center — https://htlegalcenter.org/ — Trains and supports pro bono lawyers taking trafficking cases, and maintains a public database of federal civil trafficking cases. Two uses: finding counsel, and checking what has already been argued and what damages courts have actually awarded. — kind: institution — skind: legalaid — tags: organizing:legal ; conserve:legalaid ; courts:civil — voice: interpretive
National Immigrant Justice Center — https://immigrantjustice.org/ — Free and low-cost immigration representation, including T and U visa work for trafficking and crime victims. Relevant because in most US cases the immigration question has to be handled before, not after, anyone talks to law enforcement. — kind: institution — skind: legalaid — tags: organizing:legal ; conserve:legalaid — voice: interpretive
Polaris — donate — https://polarisproject.org/donate/ — Funds the national hotline directly, which is the single piece of US infrastructure that a person in this situation can reach without going through police. — kind: institution — skind: ngo — tags: organizing:fund — voice: interpretive
Childhelp National Child Abuse Hotline — https://childhelphotline.org/ — 1-800-422-4453, twenty-four hours, in over 170 languages. Staffed by counsellors rather than call handlers, takes anonymous reports about a child, and can tell you what the mandatory-reporting rules are in your specific state before you decide what to do. — kind: institution — skind: helpline — tags: conserve:child ; conserve:hotline — voice: interpretive

46.list: Cotton Campaign — institutional — https://www.cottoncampaign.org/ — The coalition that ran the Uzbek cotton boycott for more than a decade and lifted it in 2022 after systemic state-imposed forced labour in the harvest was found to have ended. Its archive is the fullest case study anywhere of a sustained commodity campaign that worked — and it now runs the same pressure on Turkmenistan. — kind: advocacy — scope: own — skind: ngo — tags: advocacy:watchdog ; projects:trackers — trust: record — voice: commentary

47.list: Blue Dragon Children's Foundation — https://www.bluedragon.org/ — Carries out rescues of trafficked children and adults from within Vietnam and from across the Chinese border, then handles the aftercare, schooling and prosecutions.
